title: WhenToApplyPreEmergent ZIP/ZCTA GDD50 row
description: Public row contract for the derived base-50°F GDD data product.

zcta5.description: Five-character U.S. Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area code; this is not a USPS delivery-area boundary.

state_fips.description: Two-character state FIPS code for the state containing the greatest total ZCTA land-area share after summing all county intersections by state.

state_code.description: USPS-style two-letter state or territory abbreviation for grouping only.

centroid_latitude_degrees.description: Representative latitude from the Census ZCTA Gazetteer.

centroid_longitude_degrees.description: Representative longitude from the Census ZCTA Gazetteer.

gdd_base_f.description: Base temperature subtracted from each daily mean; fixed at 50°F for this release.

accumulation_start_date.description: Calendar date at which annual GDD accumulation begins, always January 1 of source_year.

observation_start_date.description: First NOAA observation date with both TMAX and TMIN at the selected station.

observation_end_date.description: Last NOAA observation date with both TMAX and TMIN at the selected station.

days_with_observations.description: Count of source-year days with both TMAX and TMIN used in the accumulation.

cumulative_gdd_f_degree_days.description: Sum of max(0, (TMAX°F + TMIN°F) / 2 - 50°F) over available observation days.

station_id.description: GHCN-Daily station identifier selected for this ZCTA.

station_distance_km.description: Haversine distance from the Census ZCTA representative point to the selected station.

fallback_rank.description: Selected station rank by distance; 1 is the nearest candidate and values above 1 are fallbacks.

station_candidate_count.description: Maximum number of nearest active stations considered by the release pipeline.

freshness_status.description: fresh, stale, or unavailable relative to freshness_max_lag_days at generation time.

freshness_age_days.description: Whole UTC days from observation_end_date to release generation; null when data are unavailable.

freshness_max_lag_days.description: Maximum accepted observation lag used by the release pipeline.

data_available.description: True when a fresh station record produced a GDD value for the ZCTA.

unavailable_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for a missing GDD value: no_recent_station_data or no_station_data.
